crossRefs.note: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep…
On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet, They cast up against me their ways of destruction.
He went up from there to Bethel. As he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and…
The people will be oppressed, everyone by another, and everyone by his neighbor. The child will behave himself proudly…

translations.web: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.
translations.bsb: Even little boys scorn me; when I appear, they deride me.
translations.kjv: Yea, young children despised me; I arose, and they spake
translations.asv: Even young children despise me; If I arise, they speak against me.
